title: Checkout API latency spike
summary: Checkout API became slow because Redis had no free connections in the pool. Users experienced 5-10 second response times during peak traffic.
root_cause: Redis connection pool exhausted. Pool size was 64 but concurrent connections peaked at 200+.
fix: Increase Redis connection pool size from 64 to 128. Set idle connection timeout to 30 seconds.

title: Kafka brokers unavailable
summary: Kafka brokers went down causing message queue backup. All event-driven services stopped processing. Producer queues filled up and started dropping messages.
root_cause: Kafka brokers crashed due to disk space exhaustion. Log retention policy was set too high.
fix: Restart Kafka brokers. Reduce log retention from 7 days to 24 hours. Add disk space monitoring alerts.

title: CPU spike in payment service
summary: Payment service CPU usage hit 100% causing request timeouts. The service was stuck in an infinite retry loop calling a downstream API.
root_cause: Infinite retry loop in payment gateway client. Exponential backoff was not implemented. Each failed request spawned 3 retries.
fix: Add exponential backoff with max 3 retries. Add circuit breaker pattern. Set retry delay to 1s, 2s, 4s.

title: Database connection timeout
summary: Primary PostgreSQL database became unreachable. All services experienced connection timeouts. Read replicas continued working but lagged behind.
root_cause: Database connection pool maxed out at 100 connections. Long-running analytical queries were holding connections for minutes.
fix: Move analytical queries to read replicas. Increase connection pool to 200. Add query timeout of 30 seconds.

title: Worker pods OOM killed
summary: Background worker pods were repeatedly OOM killed by Kubernetes. Job processing stopped and queue depth grew to millions.
root_cause: Memory leak in image processing worker. Large images were not being garbage collected. Heap grew to 4GB before OOM.
fix: Fix memory leak by explicitly releasing image buffers after processing. Set memory limit to 2GB. Add horizontal pod autoscaler.

title: Redis timeout in session service
summary: Session service started timing out on all Redis calls. Users were getting logged out randomly. Session lookup latency went from 2ms to 5000ms.
root_cause: Redis cluster node failure caused connection pool saturation. Failover took 45 seconds. During failover, all connections were retrying simultaneously.
fix: Configure Redis client retry with exponential backoff. Add circuit breaker for Redis calls. Implement session caching layer in-memory.

title: Kafka consumer lag spike
summary: Kafka consumer lag grew from 0 to 10 million messages in 10 minutes. Downstream services were processing stale data. Alerts fired for data freshness.
root_cause: Consumer group rebalance storm. A buggy consumer was frequently joining and leaving the group, triggering repeated rebalances.
fix: Fix consumer heartbeat configuration. Set session.timeout.ms to 30000. Implement cooperative sticky assignor. Fix the buggy consumer.

title: API gateway 502 errors
summary: API gateway started returning 502 Bad Gateway for 30% of requests. All upstream services were healthy. Load balancer health checks were passing.
root_cause: SSL certificate expired on internal service mesh. Gateway could not establish TLS connections to upstream services.
fix: Renew SSL certificates. Implement automated certificate rotation. Add certificate expiry monitoring with 7-day advance alerts.

title: Disk space exhaustion on Kafka
summary: Kafka brokers ran out of disk space. New messages were being rejected. Existing consumers could still read but producers were failing.
root_cause: Log retention set to 30 days for a high-throughput topic. Disk usage grew beyond 95% and brokers entered read-only mode.
fix: Reduce log retention to 7 days. Add disk usage alerts at 80% threshold. Move to larger disks. Implement tiered storage.

title: Memory leak in payment worker
summary: Payment processing worker memory grew from 500MB to 3GB over 6 hours. Worker was eventually OOM killed. Payment processing halted for 30 minutes.
root_cause: Database connection objects not being closed properly in error paths. Each failed transaction leaked a connection object.
fix: Add defer conn.Close() in all error paths. Use connection pooling with max lifetime of 5 minutes. Add memory monitoring.

title: PostgreSQL slow queries
summary: Application response time degraded from 100ms to 5 seconds. Database CPU was at 100%. All queries were running slow, not just specific ones.
root_cause: Missing index on orders table. A new feature added a query filtering by status without creating an index. Full table scan on 10M rows.
fix: Create index on orders(status, created_at). Add query performance monitoring. Implement index review in PR process.

title: Kubernetes pod scheduling failures
summary: New pods were stuck in Pending state. Existing pods continued running but no new deployments were possible. Scaling was blocked.
root_cause: Node resource fragmentation. Most nodes had 2GB free RAM but pods needed 4GB contiguous. No node had enough contiguous resources.
fix: Implement pod defragmentation. Use node affinity rules. Add resource request limits. Consider overprovisioning with low-priority pods.

title: Redis cluster split-brain
summary: Two different Redis masters were serving writes for the same data. Clients connected to different masters got inconsistent data. Cache corruption detected.
root_cause: Network partition between Redis nodes. Cluster failed to properly elect single master. Both nodes promoted themselves.
fix: Increase cluster-node-timeout to 15000. Add majority-write consensus. Implement data reconciliation job. Monitor cluster health.

title: Kafka topic partition unbalanced
summary: One Kafka partition was receiving 10x more messages than others. Consumer for that partition was overloaded while others were idle.
root_cause: Producer using sticky partitioning with a hot key. All messages with the same user_id went to the same partition.
fix: Implement key salting. Use custom partitioner with round-robin. Redistribute partition keys. Consider increasing partition count.

title: Database replication lag
summary: Read replicas were 30 seconds behind primary. Users saw stale data after writes. Read-after-write consistency was broken.
root_cause: Large bulk insert operations overwhelming replication. A batch job inserting 1M rows caused replication lag spike.
fix: Split batch inserts into smaller chunks. Implement read-your-writes consistency. Add replication lag monitoring with alerts.

title: Redis pub/sub message loss
summary: Real-time notifications stopped working. Users were not receiving live updates. Redis pub/sub subscribers were not getting messages.
root_cause: Redis pub/sub is fire-and-forget. During network blip, disconnected subscribers lost all published messages permanently.
fix: Migrate critical notifications to Redis Streams. Implement message acknowledgment. Add dead letter queue for failed deliveries.

title: Circuit breaker cascade
summary: Service A called Service B which called Service C. Service C was slow, causing Service B's circuit breaker to open, which caused Service A's to open too.
root_cause: All services had the same circuit breaker timeout of 5 seconds. No cascading fallback. No bulkhead isolation between services.
fix: Implement different timeout levels per service. Add bulkhead pattern. Implement fallback responses. Add circuit breaker dashboards.

title: Kafka producer backpressure
summary: Kafka producers started buffering messages in memory. Application heap grew rapidly. GC pauses increased to 10 seconds. Producer throughput dropped to zero.
root_cause: Kafka broker was slow to acknowledge writes. Producer buffer was full. Blocking send was used instead of async. Backpressure propagated to application.
fix: Switch to async producer with callback. Increase buffer.memory to 64MB. Add producer metrics monitoring. Implement backpressure-aware flow control.

title: PostgreSQL lock contention
summary: Database queries were timing out waiting for locks. Multiple services were trying to update the same rows. Deadlock errors appeared in logs.
root_cause: Two services updating user_balance table simultaneously without proper transaction isolation. Long-held row locks caused cascading timeouts.
fix: Implement optimistic locking with version columns. Reduce transaction scope. Add retry logic for deadlocks. Separate read/write paths.

title: Redis memory fragmentation
summary: Redis used 4GB RAM but only stored 1GB of data. Evictions started happening despite having apparent free memory. Performance degraded significantly.
root_cause: High churn rate of small objects caused memory fragmentation. Redis allocator was not releasing freed memory back to OS.
fix: Enable active-defrag. Set activedefrag yes in config. Restart Redis during low-traffic window. Monitor mem_fragmentation_ratio.
